records.value: For university/university-college higher education, applicants need admission, full-time study, an approved/accredited institution, and a study permit for studies exceeding three months.
For university/university-college study, the applicant must document at least NOK 15,488 per month or NOK 170,368 for the academic year; tuition must also be covered where applicable.

Italy requires foreign nationals to demonstrate adequate means of support for subsistence and return; for study visas, suitable personal/family or qualifying institutional financial guarantees may be used, while a bank guarantee or insurance policy is not itself accepted as the study-finance proof described by the Ministry FAQ.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
